title: Thai Green Chicken Curry with Aubergine
summary: A fragrant Thai-style green curry with tender chicken, silky aubergine and creamy coconut milk. It is warming, fresh and satisfying for a gluten-free weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: chicken breast, sliced into bite-sized strips

steps: Rinse the white rice, then cook it according to the packet instructions while you make the curry. Keep warm once tender and fluffy.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large pan over a medium-high heat. Add the onion and cook for 3–4 minutes until softened and just starting to colour.
Add the garlic, ginger, green chilli, curry powder, ground coriander and cumin. Stir for 1 minute until fragrant, taking care not to burn the spices.
Add the chicken strips and salt. Cook for 4–5 minutes, stirring often, until the outside of the chicken is no longer pink.
Add the aubergine and green bell pepper, stirring to coat them in the spiced oil. Cook for 3 minutes until the aubergine begins to soften at the edges.
Pour in the coconut milk, tamari, lime juice and brown sugar. Stir well, bring to a gentle simmer, then reduce the heat to medium-low.
Simmer uncovered for 12–15 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through, the aubergine is tender and the sauce has thickened slightly.
Add the green beans and simmer for a further 3–4 minutes until bright green and tender-crisp.
Stir through the basil and coriander. Taste and adjust with a little more salt or lime juice if needed, then serve the curry hot with the rice.
